description: This file is a CLI script for linting code snippets extracted from markdown files within a documentation project. It supports multiple languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, Java) and integrates with various linters and tools to process code snippets, generate metrics, and report errors.

classes.name: LintingService
classes.description: Base class for code linting services supporting different languages.

classes.name: PythonLintingService
classes.description: Python code linting service invoking a Python script.

classes.name: CSharpLintingService
classes.description: C# code linting service invoking a dotnet project.

classes.name: JavaLintingService
classes.description: Java code linting service invoking a Java JAR.

classes.name: LintingServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate and manage different linting services based on language.

methods.name: getAllMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects all markdown files in a directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function that orchestrates parsing markdown files, extracting code snippets, linting, and reporting.

methods.name: _writeTempSnippetsFile
methods.description: Writes code snippets to a temporary JSON file.

methods.name: spawnAsync
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run external linters or scripts asynchronously.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the linting service supports a given language.

methods.name: _lintSnippet
methods.description: Lints a single code snippet using the appropriate linter.

methods.name: lintAndReport
methods.description: Runs linting on all snippets and reports metrics and errors.

methods.name: reportMetrics
methods.description: Outputs linting metrics and error status.

methods.name: _collectMetrics
methods.description: Records metrics for a given language and result.
